currentRoundInspection.scope: Specific modern Stadion Wankdorf/Stade de Suisse, not the demolished predecessor. Own native rectangular stadium/integrated base; broad flat solar canopy and translucent inner strip/closed wing underside/visible support frame, screened facade with recessed ground glazing, two dark seating tiers/pale aisles/yellow access accents and projecting south hospitality belt, neutral football field/goals/supported end displays/small rooftop service cabin. Ordinary 2005–2013 published reference appearance; no copied lettering/seat artwork/crowd graphics, hidden furnished interiors, independent adjoining development or whole precinct slab.
